setting.label: 1912 CE · Final frame at the end of the Meiji era
setting.note: The retelling explicitly places the father’s illness and Sensei’s final testament around Emperor Meiji’s death and General Nogi’s subsequent death in 1912. Earlier remembered events predate this frame; 1914 remains the separate work date.

description: Retells Sōseki’s Kokoro through a student’s friendship with Sensei, his father’s illness, and the testament that reveals Sensei’s inheritance dispute, betrayal of his friend K, and secrecy within his marriage. The confession arrives at the end of the Meiji era and leaves the student with an unresolved obligation.
